These compounds all have a shared target of SVAT, indicating a possible mechanism of action involving SVAT. The high scores from the paths suggest a strong, consistent relationship between CID 10463877 and SVAT, likely through the modulation of KVGD3, which may influence SVAT function. The recurring involvement of KVGD3 as a target suggests a common biological pathway, possibly related to ion channel regulation or neurotransmitter transport. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between CID 10463877 and SVAT, but further validation is needed to confirm the exact role of KVGD3 in this relationship.
